owner_instruction: Three concurrent ClayCode instances must network their findings and fuse after all workers finish.
shared_goal: Revise ClayCode into a genuinely general-purpose programming language capable of implementing arbitrary application classes while preserving typed capability/effect safety, FRANK semantic contracts, TCQS, and recoverability.

coordination_protocol.join: Each active ClayCode worker reads this RENDEZVOUS and all sibling WORKER_*.json / CONTRIBUTION_*.md files before finalizing.
coordination_protocol.write: Each worker writes only its own append-only worker/contribution files; do not overwrite another worker file.
coordination_protocol.cross_read: Before close, each worker must reread all available sibling contributions and record accepted/refined/rejected deltas.
coordination_protocol.fusion: When all three workers are COMPLETE or explicitly CLOSED, one worker performs a final ClayCode fusion over all three contributions, preserving disagreements and negative results.
coordination_protocol.promotion: No shared-ancestry agreement counts as independent replication; no canonical promotion without normal gates.
coordination_protocol.conflict_avoidance: Do not update this rendezvous file concurrently. State changes are represented by new append-only receipts.

lanes.goal: universality, language core, type/effect/capability separation, arbitrary application expressiveness
prompt-injection/safety adversaries, destructive effects, capability laundering, soundness/falsifiers

mandatory_shared_questions: Can ClayCode express destructive/admin/device operations even though execution requires explicit authority?
Can it implement CLI, GUI, web server/client, game, database, compiler/JIT, GPU/ML, embedded/robotics, kernel/driver-class software through typed lowerings/FFI?
Does the safety architecture constrain authority rather than computational expressiveness?
Which operations require host capabilities, and can those capabilities be forged, widened, laundered or ambiently inherited?
Can arbitrary computation be expressed by a small universal pure/control core independent of effects?
